lines.text: The servant woke at dawn and froze — an army had surrounded the city overnight.
He ran back in shaking: Alas, my master! How shall we do?
Elisha didn't argue with what his servant saw. He just prayed one sentence: LORD, open his eyes, that he may see.
And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire.
Nothing outside the city changed. What changed was what he could see.
Whatever surrounds you today, more surrounds it. Fear not — they that be with us are more than they that be with them. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: They That Be With Us Are More
story: A three-scene illustrated short film on 2 Kings 6:15-17: a servant frozen with fear at a mist-grey dawn wall as an army surrounds the city, Elisha kneeling in prayer as a single shaft of gold breaks the grey, and the same hillside revealed ablaze with horses and chariots of fire as the servant finally sees what surrounded him all along.
